spec_match.rationale: One named shared worker receives a connect event per page, frame and tab and logs each data value.

interactive.rationale: Join, add/remove member frames, open a real tab; live roster and connect log.

edge_cases.rationale: Frame removal relies on pagehide to say bye; a crashed tab would stay in the roster.

references.rationale: Links the chromestatus.com/feature/<id> entry and the spec section.

conformance.rationale: Uses the same worker as the suite.

runtime_evidence.rationale: Headless Chromium 153.0.8010.12 via Playwright: joined, two frames connected, log shows uniform null data across clients (legacy build); frame removal updated the roster.

telemetry_health.rationale: Asserts join and uniform data across clients.

design_system.rationale: Only design-system CSS variables (shared demo.css), buttons set background and color together, AA contrast verdict colours.

accessibility.rationale: Labelled native controls, keyboard operable, visible focus, verdicts in polite live regions, tables with captions and scoped headers.

mobile_desktop_parity.rationale: Driven headless at 1280x800 and 360x740 DPR3 touch: 0px horizontal overflow, all controls ≥44px, zero console errors or failed requests.

openQuestions.title: Prune dead ports
openQuestions.detail: Add a heartbeat so the hub drops members whose pagehide never arrived.

guidanceConsulted.query: live region status updates for asynchronous results
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Announce asynchronous verdicts through polite live regions; give every control a programmatic label; keep visible focus.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Verdicts and outputs are aria-live polite (high-frequency readouts use aria-live off), every select/input has a <label for>, focus-visible outline via demo.css.

guidanceConsulted.query: responsive control panel without horizontal overflow mobile
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Let control rows wrap, constrain form controls to the container, and wrap long monospace strings.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Flex-wrap control rows, labels/selects max-width 100%, tables in overflow-x containers, overflow-wrap:anywhere on outputs and long breadcrumbs; 0px document overflow measured at 360px.

guidanceConsulted.query: feature detection unknown dictionary member ignored
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Detect support from an observable behaviour difference, never from the absence of an exception.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Support verdicts use reflection/TypeError or the real returned value, so an ignoring browser reports unsupported.

guidanceConsulted.query: responsive control panel without horizontal overflow mobile
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Use intrinsic grid sizing (minmax(min(100%, X), 1fr)) instead of fixed columns.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: grid-2 and member grids use auto-fit minmax(min(100%, 16rem), 1fr).

summary: One named shared worker receives a connect event per page, frame and tab and logs each data value. Headless Chromium 153.0.8010.12 via Playwright: joined, two frames connected, log shows uniform null data across clients (legacy build); frame removal updated the roster.
